name: wordcraft-edge-mcp

tools.name: doc_create
tools.description: WordCraft makes and edits documents. To make a new document, call doc_create. When the user attaches a document, its absolute path is provided in context: open that exact path with WordCraft, inspect and edit it, save under a new name, then call file_attach so the user can download it. Never write Python or other code to create, read or edit a document. To give the user any file a tool wrote, call file_attach with its path. Create a styled, editable DOCX from Markdown and return its download in one call. Limits: 512 KiB Markdown, 4000 blocks/cells, tables 200 rows/16 columns, no images, 32 MiB output. Page size letter or a4; margin in points (36..108), font and font_size (9..16). Never overwrites.

tools.name: file_attach
tools.description: Return a regular file as downloadable MCP resource content; supports DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, PDF and CSV, at most 32 MiB. Call after saving an edited document.

path.description: Exact file path inside the root

tools.name: list_commands
tools.description: Every WordCraft command: id, label, ribbon location, shortcut and params. Filter with `query`.

tools.name: execute
tools.description: Run one command by id with params, e.g. {command:"format.bold"} or {command:"insert.table", params:{rows:3, cols:4}}. Commands work on the active document, or on the open document `doc` names. file.new and file.open open another document beside the open ones and make it active; view.switchWindows {id} makes another one active and file.closeDocument {id, force?} closes one.

doc.description: Id of the open document to work on (list_documents); the active document when left out. The active document stays active.

tools.name: batch
tools.description: Run commands in order; stops at the first error unless keepGoing. `doc` sends every command to that open document.

doc.description: Id of the open document to work on (list_documents); the active document when left out. The active document stays active.

tools.name: new_document
tools.description: Start a document: blank, sample, letter, resume or report. It opens beside the documents already open and becomes the active one; the reply's `id` addresses it (`doc`).

tools.name: open_document
tools.description: WordCraft makes and edits documents. To make a new document, call doc_create. When the user attaches a document, its absolute path is provided in context: open that exact path with WordCraft, inspect and edit it, save under a new name, then call file_attach so the user can download it. Never write Python or other code to create, read or edit a document. To give the user any file a tool wrote, call file_attach with its path. Open a .docx, .doc, .odt, .rtf, .md, .tex, .html, .txt or .json file, or any other text file (.m3u, .log, .ini…) as plain text. Give `password` for a protected file; without it the call fails asking for one. The file opens beside the documents already open (it replaces a blank one nobody has used) and becomes the active one; a file that is already open becomes active again (`alreadyOpen`). The reply's `id` addresses it (`doc`).

password.description: Password, if the file is protected

tools.name: save_document
tools.description: Save (format from the extension: docx, pdf, odt, rtf, html, md, tex, txt, png).

doc.description: Id of the open document to work on (list_documents); the active document when left out. The active document stays active.

path.description: File path; rooted mode chooses a new DOCX name when omitted and never overwrites

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type at the caret (replacing the selection). Use \n... for line breaks inside text; use execute text.newParagraph for new paragraphs, or `paragraphs: true` to split lines into paragraphs (one undo step, at most 10000 lines).

doc.description: Id of the open document to work on (list_documents); the active document when left out. The active document stays active.

tools.name: select_text
tools.description: Select the n-th occurrence of some text.

doc.description: Id of the open document to work on (list_documents); the active document when left out. The active document stays active.

tools.name: get_text
tools.description: Body text with tracked deletions omitted.

doc.description: Id of the open document to work on (list_documents); the active document when left out. The active document stays active.

tools.name: inspect_document
tools.description: Structure: blocks with text, styles, formatting runs, lists, tables, sections, parts, selection, pages.

doc.description: Id of the open document to work on (list_documents); the active document when left out. The active document stays active.

tools.name: render_page
tools.description: Render a page to PNG to look at the result.

doc.description: Id of the open document to work on (list_documents); the active document when left out. The active document stays active.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: The open documents in the order they were opened: id, title, path, dirty (unsaved changes) and active (the one commands work on by default). new_document and open_document open another document beside these. Give a document's id as `doc` to execute, batch, type_text, select_text, get_text, inspect_document, render_page or save_document to work on it while it stays in the background; execute view.switchWindows {id} makes it the active one, file.closeDocument {id, force?} closes it.

tools.name: key

tools.name: ui_inspect
tools.description: UI state: tab, panes, dialog, page rectangles on screen, caret (desktop app only).

instructions: WordCraft makes and edits documents. To make a new document, call doc_create. When the user attaches a document, its absolute path is provided in context: open that exact path with WordCraft, inspect and edit it, save under a new name, then call file_attach so the user can download it. Never write Python or other code to create, read or edit a document. To give the user any file a tool wrote, call file_attach with its path. Use inspect_document and get_text to inspect the opened structure. Select text and type_text to replace it; execute and batch reach formatting, tables, find/replace and review commands. list_commands discovers command parameters. Check import warnings: modeled formatting is preserved, but unsupported DOCX content may change or be lost. Rooted saves always publish a new file, preserving uploads. tool_search discovers other tools; tool_call returns their exact content, including files. Tools accept doc to address an open document without switching it. Backend: headless session (no window). Community: https://discord.gg/artcraft · https://getartcraft.com/apps/wordcraft · https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft
